title: Meet the board
caption: Nine points. Follow the carved lines between them.

title: A game of three
caption: Black and white each have three stones.

title: Nine places to play
caption: Stones sit on the nine points where the lines meet.

title: Three stones each
caption: Count three black stones and three white stones.

title: Find your line
caption: Black can complete the top row by placing at the highlighted point.

title: Three in a row
caption: A horizontal, vertical or diagonal line wins—even during placement.

title: Small board, big decisions
caption: Look at both colours before choosing your next point.

title: Follow the lines
caption: The centre connects directly to all eight outer points.

title: One connection
caption: Black can move from the top-left point to the empty top-middle point.

title: Black places first
caption: Begin by placing one black stone on any empty point.

title: One stone at a time
caption: After black places, white takes a turn.

title: Any empty point
caption: During placement, you do not have to follow a connection.

title: White answers
caption: Each turn belongs to the other player after you place.

title: All six are down
caption: If nobody has won, the next turn begins movement.

title: Your starting position
caption: Your placements decide which moves will be available later.

title: Place with a plan
caption: A stone in the centre has connections in every direction.

title: The centre
caption: Eight connections pass through this point. Occupied points still block movement.

title: The corners
caption: Each corner connects to the centre and its two neighbouring edge points.

title: Leave room to move
caption: This empty neighbour gives black a route out of the corner.

title: Look at all three
caption: The highlighted points show black's three stones. Consider how they work together.

title: Time to move
caption: All six stones are placed. Black now moves a stone instead of adding one.

title: Move to a neighbour
caption: Follow the arrow across one connection to an empty point.

title: An empty destination
caption: The centre stone can move right because that neighbouring point is empty.

title: No jumping
caption: Black cannot move from top-left to bottom-right: the centre is occupied. Never cross more than one connection.

title: Move to defend
caption: White threatens the right column. Black can move from the centre to block it.

title: What did you leave?
caption: Moving this black stone leaves the centre empty for the other player.

title: Connected, not just close
caption: A diagonal step from the centre to bottom-left is legal: there is a drawn connection.

title: Check the new position
caption: This move occupies the right-middle point and opens the centre. Look at both changes.

title: Work together
caption: Black's two top-row stones support a winning placement at the third point.

title: See the whole board
caption: Black threatens the top row; white threatens the middle row. Notice both.

title: Two make a threat
caption: Two black stones line up. The empty top-right point completes their row.

title: Three completes it
caption: Place at top-right to complete the line and win immediately.

title: Watch the opponent
caption: White's top-right and bottom-right stones threaten the empty point between them.

title: Close the gap
caption: Move black into the right-middle point to stop white completing that column.

title: Defence and attack
caption: Placing at right-middle blocks white's row and leaves black threatening the top row. Here, black could also win immediately at top-right.

title: Think one turn ahead
caption: After blocking right-middle, the centre is open. Consider white's reply before moving.

title: More than one threat
caption: Both players have two stones in a row. Check every line, not just the first one you spot.

title: Keep your options
caption: Black's centre stone has three empty neighbours: top-middle, right-middle and bottom-left.

title: Take away an option
caption: Occupying right-middle removes white's immediate winning destination.

title: Your move
caption: Before every turn: check for a win, check the opponent's threats, then check the connections.
